summary: Freeport-McMoRan Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that it entered into a new five-year $3.0 billion senior unsecured revolving credit facility, replacing its prior facility maturing in 2027. The new facility is substantially similar, with a $500 million sublimit for subsidiary PT Freeport Indonesia and a $1.5 billion letter-of-credit sublimit, maturing May 14, 2031. There were no borrowings outstanding at termination. The agreement contains standard negative covenants and a 3.75x leverage ratio covenant. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable.
